item_title: Chief justice: Judges' safety ‘essential’ to court system
item_description: Jessica Gresko / Associated Press:  — With security threats to Supreme Court justices still fresh memories, Chief Justice John Roberts on Saturday praised programs that protect judges, saying that “we must support judges by ensuring their safety.”

item_title: Benedict XVI, first pope to resign in 600 years, dies at 95
item_description: Nicole Winfield / Associated Press:  — Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI, the shy German theologian who tried to reawaken Christianity in a secularized Europe but will forever be remembered as the first pontiff in 600 years to resign from the job, died Saturday. He was 95.
